proof.comparison: Strictly greater optimistic strategic HP deficit only; equality remains searchable. HP precedes potion cost, growth counters and turns after victory/death-save/theft. Exact potion audits and forced/disabled/quota requests cannot consume this cross-prefix fallback.
proof.ownership: Immutable PrimarySearchIncumbent value through PlanMemberExecution/ContinuationSearchRequest; no live reads, mutable state cache, RNG consumption or ranking backfill.

qualification.rootStampCheck: All compared with prior frozen roots by SHA256; full source inventories separately captured for four newly reviewed roots.
qualification.scope: Specific eleven frozen roots, not all native content or all five-character encounters.

sourceAuditReuse.scope: Same pinned game, exact component source and premises;31 initial card classes/nine relics and related Powers plus prior eight closed native generation pools. from pathlib import Path
import json, os, subprocess, time

base = Path.cwd()
task = base / '.local/tool-tasks/open-potion-primary-proof-20261007'
previous = json.loads((base / 'docs/performance/zero-credit-growth-hp-pruning-20261007.json').read_text())
records = []
for scene in ['dev-04-necrobinder-elite', 'dev-06-silent-boss']:
    control = next(r for r in previous['performance']['finalRuns'] if r['scene'] == scene and r['label'] == 'C1')
    out = task / 'diagnostic' / scene
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    cmd = control['plan']['command'].copy()
    cmd[cmd.index('--out') + 1] = str(out)
    cmd[cmd.index('--label') + 1] = 'open-potion-proof-' + scene
    env = os.environ.copy()
    for key in list(env):
        if key.startswith('OFFLINE_HARNESS_') or key.startswith('COMBATSOLVER_VERIFY') or key in ['DOTNET_PerfMapEnabled', 'COMPlus_PerfMapEnabled', 'COMBATSOLVER_MEASUREMENT_TRACE']:
            env.pop(key, None)
    env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL'] = str(task / 'build-diagnostic/CombatSolver.dll')
    (out / 'command.json').write_text(json.dumps({'command': cmd, 'outerTimeoutSeconds': 120, 'diagnosticInstrumentation': True, 'sourceBase': '75a3266d', 'runtimeBase': '5f47de56', 'frozenInputHashReuse': control['plan']['requestSha256']}, indent=2) + '\n')
    start = time.monotonic()
    with (out / 'launcher.log').open('w') as log:
        proc = subprocess.Popen(cmd, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        try:
            code = proc.wait(timeout=120)
            status = 'Completed' if code == 0 else 'Failed'
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            proc.kill(); proc.wait()
            code, status = proc.returncode, 'TimeoutNoRetry'
    record = {'scene': scene, 'status': status, 'exitCode': code, 'launcherWallSeconds': time.monotonic() - start, 'path': str(out / 'result.json'), 'command': cmd}
    if status == 'Completed':
        result = json.loads((out / 'result.json').read_text())
        record.update({k: result[k] for k in ['wallSeconds', 'peakProcessWorkingSetBytes', 'comparisonQuality', 'budget', 'solverMetrics', 'pruneCounters']})
        record['policy'] = json.loads((out / 'search-policy.json').read_text())
        record['rootContinuationStamp'] = result['rootContinuationStamp']
        record['observations'] = []
        for path in (out / 'logs').rglob('process.jsonl'):
            for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
                message = json.loads(line)['Message']
                if 'TASK_OPEN_POTION_PROOF ' in message:
                    record['observations'].append(json.loads(message.split('TASK_OPEN_POTION_PROOF ', 1)[1]))
    records.append(record)
    (task / 'observer-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({k: record.get(k) for k in ['scene', 'status', 'wallSeconds', 'comparisonQuality']}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
    if status != 'Completed':
        raise SystemExit('Terminal failure retained; do not retry unchanged timeout.')

from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,hashlib
base=Path.cwd();task=base/'.local/tool-tasks/open-potion-primary-proof-20261007';dll=task/'build-candidate-v4/CombatSolver.dll'
for label,scene in [('retained-plain','ZERO-CREDIT-GROWTH-PROOF'),('retained-regen','ZERO-CREDIT-GROWTH-PROOF-REGEN')]:
 out=task/('native-'+label);out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 cmd=['bash','tools/testing/run-unattended-test.sh','--scenario-id',scene,'--character-id','NECROBINDER','--encounter-id','NIBBITS_WEAK','--seed','PRUNING-OUTCOME-DOMINANCE-20261007','--combat-solver-build-dir',str(dll.parent),'--headless-instance','retained-primary-'+label+'-20261007','--timeout-seconds','120','--evidence-directory',str(out),'--cleanup-instance-on-exit','--exit-on-complete']
 (task/('native-'+label+'-command.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'command':cmd,'dllSha256':hashlib.sha256(dll.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},indent=2)+'\n')
 with (task/('native-'+label+'.log')).open('w') as f:r=subprocess.run(cmd,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 d=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_text()) if (out/'result.json').exists() else {}

后期能力计划启动前，协调器已经持有当前政策允许的完整获胜路线。追加搜索只在原比较器认定更优时替换它，否则保留该路线。新入口把这个事实与“精确用几瓶药”的专门审核区分：固定前缀和未来可能用药，并不阻止追加搜索与已保留胜利比较；精确用药层仍不能因此提前结束或替代反事实结果。
